content: Ju̱denunijyu̱ jachipiya̱jo jiryatiy mucadinchara, rataryajo jiryatiy jarichunchantirya

Ravichanu̱yada ji̱ta su̱teda munatya jiñiquejadamu nu̱tyuramusiy riryi jachipiya̱sara nijya̱nvay sanijyu̱ Ju̱denu. Ravichanu̱yada sanijyu̱ jachipiya̱jo jiyu mucadinchantiy, jiryatiy riryoriiyada ra̱jiju̱ donajatyara. Munatya cuartu jiryatiy bimu na̱cho̱sirya, ru̱tachara Ju̱denuju̱ jiintyasarára jasityi ravichanu̱yada no̱no̱siichuma, mi̱sa jarye, ranchatiy ribeñu̱yadara pa̱ Ju̱denu diya.
Munatya cuartu jiyadaju̱ ravichanu̱yada ratarya cuartuntiy, mutanujay jiyada, jiryatiy ru̱tachara jaryi samiryava̱ju̱ Ju̱denu jtedamuju̱ra.

Jasiñi̱ ravichanu̱yada vu̱rudi juru rupajyo, órutera, jadchintyi rasasi jiryatiy Ju̱denu niquejadajiju̱ra, jiryatiy órujatya mutanusarára. Ravimu ji̱ta ravichanu̱yada jiimo̱, órutera, jiryatiy Ju̱denu paji vichanu̱yada ravimu, jadchintyi Arú̱bay ruvese jiryatiy radipuvesubeda rajii, jadchintyi ravichu̱ padyejyu̱y jarye, jasityi nu̱charara Ju̱denu niquejada siva.

Rasasi mutaduyncha nanuvicha̱da danu̱ju̱y jantyasanu̱jyu̱y, Ju̱denu tuunu vichanu̱y jantyasanu̱jyu̱y. Nanunipya̱ canuvu̱nura ramutaduy jiryatiy ru̱tachara Ju̱denu jantyutyajora. Ne vana̱y vuryeriryi̱ tu̱chodara tara diye ranchintyi.
Jiryatiy ravichanu̱yada darya Ju̱denu roriy, caserdótevyeda jaya̱nu̱yada japichiy munatya cuartuvimu, rirya̱tidye jvaacharara yivaayada Ju̱denunijyu̱.

Vinu caserdóte nutyityu̱ ji̱ta jayada ratarya cuartuvimu taraquiju̱ nu̱ñi tanijya̱quimusiy. Ne saryijeyada netimyu̱ ne saryi jtoda yisa̱ra jasi̱ nudaja̱, jiryatiy su̱ntatya̱da jijyuuchuveda murichiryara, nijya̱nvay juuchuveda murichirya jarye ti̱ta̱ju̱, jiryatiy rijyuuchuveda jidyetyi̱sa̱damu.
Sadityadoda ji̱ta Ju̱denu Jnutu ramusirya jiryatimyu̱ ne jayadaju̱ jasiy didye Ju̱denuju̱ jiintyajovimuju̱, varimyuju̱timyu̱ ne raso̱vacha̱da munatya cuartu jadchiy didyeyu.

Rani̱ ji̱ta vichasara dityanuta̱ diye rundaju̱ day, vurya̱tidye datya nijya̱nvanchiy: Rityi jnutatyasarára sa̱chara Ju̱denunijyu̱, ru̱vacharani̱ jasi̱ sanijyu̱ntiy, ne vana̱y nta ruti̱sara samiy jvadichavay ramusiy Ju̱denu tuunuju̱.
Ruvaayada ji̱tara jiryatiy ru̱ntatya̱da sanijyu̱ra jmyichara varimyata jatusara, varimyata jiryatiy richuuta̱da sa̱jiju̱yu, ruvaayada Ju̱denu jtedamu vinu saratyadoda runda sa̱ra̱ju̱.

Samu̱ti̱jadanumatiy Crístu nu̱tyu caserdóte nutyityu̱ vuryeyadaju̱, samiryava̱ju̱ vichasa̱dajiju̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱, samu̱ti̱jada Jijye̱ rorimyu jiryatiy jaryi samiryava̱ju̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ taramusirya, jiryatimyu̱ ne jomututa jvaachara darya, dantyamu̱y ne jirya mucadimu ju̱desarara.

Sajamya̱ ju̱na̱reju̱ Ju̱denuju̱ jiintyajomuju̱. Ne su̱toda yisa̱ra jasi̱ nudaja̱, nu̱tyu voca nudaja̱, ne vinu carni̱ru nudaja̱. Su̱toda ji̱ta darya vinu yindaja̱ day, ratatiy sasaryeda ju̱na̱reju̱ra vurye̱ntyutya̱da.

Ta̱riy ripyu̱yada nijya̱nvay juuchatavay jimyi̱dodivasiyu, jiryatiy ru̱rejada caserdótevyedara carni̱ru nudaja̱ ruuva, ¡ra̱, ra̱, ra̱! ne vinu voca vanu nudaja̱ta, sadetu rupachi̱ pupujuruja̱ta jarye risa̱ju̱.

Ta̱ jaryivya̱ju̱ ra̱pu̱chara Crístu nudaja̱ vu̱jyuuchuvedivasivyu̱y, jiryatiy su̱ntatya̱da Ju̱denu ju̱na̱reju̱ vichi̱ jnutumusiyu. Su̱ntatya̱da Crístu ne juuchati̱ Ju̱denumuju̱yu, sa̱tidye pu̱rya vu̱jechipiya̱jada Ju̱denunijyu̱, va̱cha jvaayada jachipityaja̱jadajisiy, vurya̱tidye vichasara sanijyu̱ Vu̱jye̱ ju̱na̱reju̱ vichi̱.

Ramuni̱ savichasara Crístu vuryeyada rá̱ñu Ju̱denu tuunu, vadira Ju̱denu niquejada jto̱tadedaju̱. Jiryatiy sabatyeda vurye̱ntyutyasa̱daju̱, sapu̱chara variy vuryivasirya vu̱jyuuchuveda ti̱ta̱ju̱, jiryatiy vu̱jyuuchuvay munatya Ju̱denu niquejada jiyaro̱ju̱, jiryatiy Muyisésibemyusirya, vurya̱tidye jmutya̱sarara vuryeyaru̱rya ti̱ta̱ju̱, jiryatiy su̱teda Ju̱denu ya̱sa̱y jiñatuvyerya.
Vurya̱tidye jmutya̱ra vuryeyaru̱rya jiryatiy vu̱jye̱be barya ma̱cho̱rara, vurya̱datya samiy munatya si̱tenuni̱viy sadiimya̱.
Jiryatiy sabayada ti̱ra darya vicha̱da, vu̱ryi jmutya̱ dyetya su̱bivara jiberya, ne vana̱y vuryi̱mutya̱ra netimyu̱ ne sadiiy raja̱mi̱ didye.

Ramuni̱timyu̱ ne sabayada Ju̱denu munatyara jiñiquejada nudaja̱jsá̱, sireda ji̱ta Muyisésibe daryaju̱ra múrejii, sapuchodara carni̱ru jasicho variy rí̱dcha, jiryatiy ruuna̱tya muchanusarára. Jadchiy ji̱tantiy saparodeda ja̱a̱múra, jiryatiy vocadenu nudaja̱ta jaryenusara darya, carni̱ru nudaja̱ jarye risa̱ju̱, sa̱tidye ju̱re varirya nudaja̱ raniy, Ju̱denu niquejada padye, nijya̱nvañe̱cho̱ju̱ jarye.
Su̱teda Muyisésibe variy yivaayadamu:

content.text: “Jiryatirya nudaja̱ jiryatiy su̱teda Ju̱denu vurya̱rumirya, ratatiy vuryito̱tanirya saniquejada vurye̱ntyutyasa̱daju̱.”

content: Daryaday su̱rera nudaja̱ riva Ju̱denu rorintyi, ti̱ta̱ju̱ ruvaatya̱va jarye, jiryatiy ruvaatyasara caserdótevyeda Ju̱denunijyu̱ra.
Ju̱denu jtedamusiy ji̱ta riryi pu̱chara ti̱ta̱ju̱nubesiy nudaja̱tara. Nuda rubedajisiy ji̱ta ne vana̱y saramityaniy Ju̱denu vuryivara vu̱jyuuchuveda.
Crístu batyeda vu̱jyuuchuveda pu̱cha̱da jiyadaju̱
Riryityi pu̱ryu̱chara nudaja̱tara jirya Ju̱denu vichajo jantyasara, jirya ji̱ta jiryatiy jarichuvimu bachara vichajoju̱ darya, rava̱tasara jaryivya̱ju̱ra pu̱tya̱ jiryamusiy.

Tapitya sajayada Crístu ravimu Ju̱denuju̱ jiintyasajo, jiryatiy jomututa jvaachara darya, jiryatiy vinu mitya jantyasara darya. Sajayada ji̱ta si̱tenu Ju̱denu vichajovimu, jiryatiy jarichuvimu darya, jasityi samu̱ti̱sara Ju̱denu tuunu vuryeyadaju̱.

Dantyamu̱y ne sajajeya̱sara Crístu japichiy nu̱tyu jnutatyasi̱ Jijye̱myuyu, nu̱tyu caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱mityi jaachara nu̱ñi tanijya̱quimusiy Ju̱denuju̱ jiintyajovimuju̱ day, rirya̱tidye jnutatyara nudaja̱ jiryatimyu̱ ne rindaja̱ darya.
Raryityi vicha̱da daryá, saryiñi diijeya̱ japichiy mucadi ju̱desa̱damusiy. Nu̱ye ji̱ta, mucadi baryi̱ru̱yada rundamu, samu̱ti̱ma̱ taraquiju̱, sa̱tidye parutara juuchuveda jibetyedamusiy.

Daryatiy sabayada Ju̱denu nijya̱nvajyu̱ntirya taraquiju̱ diiyadantiy, sa̱murichenutanichara rivasiy vuryivaayada murichirya vu̱y, daryaday savichasara Crístu jnutatyasi̱ jidyiiyadivasintyi, sa̱tidye pu̱chicharara rajuuvay juuchuveda. Sa̱day mu̱ti̱ daraju̱jyu̱ juuchajsa̱ntiy, jivyejyu̱ jiryatiy rintuyanumucha sa̱jiju̱ jirye̱ntyutyasa̱daju̱.
